config.title: Qwen3-1.7B expanded constructive comparison
config.test_policy: Frozen test roster excluded from training and online model/policy selection.
config.notes: Fresh pinned base; rank32 LoRA. Same balanced action stream per seed. Matched updates/data, not matched compute. No test-based selection. Structured constructive proofs do not establish unrestricted HA ability.

data_manifest.checking_scope: inherits pinned constructive Python admission; not a new independent replay or Lean proof
data_manifest.encoding: separate literal prompt/action; no BOS/chat; one actual EOS; labels shift once in the trainer
data_manifest.overlap_scope: structural groups/targets disjoint; grammar families and reusable intermediate proof states may recur
data_manifest.session_rule: all admitted rows or no rows; structural split assignment never changes

test.training_access: trainer loads only train and dev files; test is a separate explicit evaluation

campaign5.initialization: fresh-pinned-base-LoRA; only exact same-identity resume is supported
campaign5.training_cost_scope: measured training wall time plus logical forward calls; backward recomputation excluded from call counts
campaign5.proof_roster_selection: ordered prefix of pinned preparation development roster

sampling.phase_definition: literal intro command is setup; all other commands are reasoning
